name: vant-dashboard
description: The dashboard auth/OTP doors + the bridge knee (web/dashboard/functions/api/auth/{request,verify}-otp.ts + session.ts + lib/bridge.ts podTokenFor/establishSession + lib/auth_guard.ts ensureAdmin), driven in-process by the run root's dash-auth probe child (Node strip-types, WHATWG Request/Response, WebCrypto; an in-child KVStore shim for the BOLETE_KV binding and a capture sink standing in for the configured email sender - no sockets, no deploy): the store-absence state answers typed, hostile bodies never fault, the mint lane is typed and budgeted, the session mints server-side under the cookie discipline law, the verify budget burns, the bridge's token resolution order is provable (header > server-bound > raw MVP cookie), the property-scoped binding never leaks, the token intake is shape-gated without token-riding cookies, the unbound fallback keeps full cookie hygiene, and the admin gate renders its typed ladder end to end. Phase A wire-surface slice of the S0->S1 campaign (#249); the dashboard's native UI suites stay green alongside.
